name: Owedly Settlements
description: App Store & Play Store screenshots for a class action settlement, refund finder, cash back or money claim app. A deep green first screenshot with a pile of 3D gold coins and four enamel emblem coins, three light mint screenshots with emerald coins, a settlement card that pops out of the phone, a matches screen and a three-step screen with a 3D receipt, a party popper, flying cash and a money bag, and a closing screenshot of payout cards over gold. Bold Plus Jakarta Sans headlines with gold and emerald accents. Every coin, object, card and phone sits in named, editable layers.
